dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Stitch was surrendered by his previous owner due to their housing situation. His previous family reports that he is very affectionate and playful once comfortable with people, loves quality time and attention, and enjoys playing with squeaky toys. During his stay in care, he has shown highly fearful behavior, baring teeth during his medical examination and vocalizing, head whipping, and thrashing when staff attempt to return him to his kennel. In calmer environments, he has shown social behavior with staff. Due to these concerns, we recommend for Stitch to be placed in an adult-only home through a New Hope partner that can allow him the time and space to decompress and acclimate at his own pace.
dog.name: Stitch
